title: Tiny, cute toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- toy block: red cube with slightly lighter top and side faces, two studs on top -->
  <!-- front face -->
  <rect x='25' y='40' width='50' height='45' rx='5' fill='#e0392f'/>
  <!-- slightly darker right side face -->
  <polygon points='75,40 85,32 85,77 75,85' fill='#b32a22'/>
  <!-- lighter top face -->
  <polygon points='25,40 35,32 85,32 75,40' fill='#ff6f60'/>
  <!-- studs on top -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='29' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ff8a7d'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='27' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ffd0c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='29' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ff8a7d'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='27' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ffd0c8'/>
  <!-- cute face on front: two eyes and a smile, in bright warm yellow -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='4' fill='#ffe45c'/>
  <path d='M40 68 Q50 76 60 68' stroke='#ffe45c' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3a0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3a0'/>
</svg>
